features.name: Covering-design wheel
features.description: From a reduced pool of numbers, build tickets so that every t-subset of the pool appears on at least one ticket. Comes with a plain-English guarantee label.
features.notes: Guarantee: if at least t of your pool numbers are drawn, >=1 ticket shows a t-match. Restructures coverage, never the odds.

features.name: Structured set
features.description: Feature-targeted set: aim for a sum range, odd/even and low/high balance, no consecutive numbers, optional hot bias, while keeping pair overlap between tickets low.
features.notes: engine_py.gen_structured - greedy minimise-overlap selection with a relax fallback

features.name: Hybrid set
features.description: 70% structured tickets plus 30% diversified random tickets - structure with some spread.
features.notes: engine_py.gen_hybrid

features.name: Curated 'Build My Play Set'
features.description: A transparent 6-step funnel: start from the full combination space, reduce to your pool, drop combos that already occurred, drop statistical 'edge' shapes, score survivors by the game's profile, then coverage-aware greedy top-N. Shows the funnel counts and coverage achieved.
features.notes: engine_py.build_play_set (F5) / lottery_general.build_curated (any game). Scores SHAPE, not likelihood.

features.name: Documented research sets
features.description: All 48 sets from the owner's research (S1/S2/A63/B63 x 12) are embedded, selectable, with a monthly rotation ('this month').
features.notes: Fantasy 5 only; grouped picker + family-selectable rotation

features.name: Backtest against history
features.description: Replay a set across every historical draw and report how often the best ticket hit >=2/3/4/5 numbers per draw.
features.notes: engine_py.backtest / lottery_general.backtest; date-windowed (All / 5y / 2y / this year)

features.name: The Brutal Ledger
features.description: The signature feature: replay a fixed set across all draws with REAL payout math, returning net profit/loss, ROI, an equity curve, tier histogram, best single draw and worst losing streak.
features.notes: engine_py.ledger_run - bitmask-accelerated; uses persisted prize + ticket-cost settings

features.name: Random quick-pick control
features.description: Compares your set's net result against thousands of equal-volume random quick-pick runs, giving the percentile you land at versus pure luck.
features.notes: engine_py.montecarlo_control - exact multinomial (numpy), microseconds; 'beat_random' verdict

features.name: Blunt AI verdict
features.description: A local AI states in 2-4 sentences whether the strategy beat random, by how much, what it cost, and the honest takeaway - no hype, no prediction claims.
features.notes: /api/ledger/verdict - SSE-streamed, statistician system prompt

features.name: Win-tier probability
features.description: Exact hypergeometric odds of >=2/3/4/5 matches for N independent tickets in one draw - and the reminder that strategy does not change them.
features.notes: engine_py.probability_profile (Appendix-A formulas)

features.name: Check winners
features.description: Enter the actual drawn numbers and see each ticket's matches highlighted, its prize tier, and the total payout.
features.notes: engine_py.check_set; uses persisted prize settings

features.name: Heat-mapped pool picker
features.description: Pick your pool on a number grid coloured by historical draw frequency, with hot / cold / random helper buttons.
features.notes: ranked_numbers / hot_numbers / cold_numbers; honest 'not predictive' caveat shown

features.name: Recent-hot & overdue chips
features.description: Surface recently-hot and most-overdue numbers, always labelled 'independent draws - not predictive'.
features.notes: Fantasy 5 heat card

features.name: Draw-history viewer
features.description: Browse, search by date/number, and delete stored draws; add a draw manually or import a CSV.
features.notes: /api/draws/list, DELETE /api/draws/{date}, /api/draws/add, /api/draws/import

features.name: Auto-update draws
features.description: Pull the latest results from official/community feeds for the loaded games, closing any gap since the last stored draw.
features.notes: F5: galottery.com + lottonumbers backfill. Universal: data.ny.gov, Caixa, FDJ, EuroMillions community.

features.name: Any lottery, config-driven
features.description: One engine handles any N-pick-k game with an optional bonus ball - Powerball, Mega Millions, EuroMillions, Mega-Sena, Quina, Lotofacil and more - selected from a preset or fully custom.
features.notes: lottery_general.py + PRESETS; verified exact odds vs published (Powerball 1/292,201,338 etc.)

features.name: Bonus-ball strategies
features.description: The bonus ball (Powerball / Mega Ball / Euro stars / Trevo / Chance) is treated honestly as an independent draw, with rotate / fixed / cover-every-value modes.
features.notes: attach_bonus(); cannot be wheeled by design

features.name: Per-game auto-derived profile
features.description: The curated builder learns each game's shape from its OWN draw history (sum hotzone, odd/low targets, low/high split) - no Fantasy-5 constants leak into other games.
features.notes: lottery_general.derive_profile

features.name: Latest Results dashboard
features.description: A single page showing every game's newest draw grouped by region (USA / Europe / Brazil), auto-refreshed from official feeds, with next-draw jackpot estimates where a reputable source exists.
features.notes: /results; jackpots from Caixa + Mega Millions official, Cash4Life fixed; Powerball/Euro honestly blank

features.name: Super Sete positional game
features.description: The Brazilian 7-column 0-9 game: mark 1-3 digits per column, see live games-count, cost and exact odds, quick-pick and build.
features.notes: /supersete; Poisson-binomial odds verified vs published (7/7 = 1 in 10,000,000)

features.name: Scratch-off EV tracker
features.description: Enter a scratch game's published prize-remaining data and get its expected value per ticket, % returned and an honest verdict - every scratch game has negative EV; this finds the least-bad.
features.notes: /scratch; EV = sum(prize x remaining)/tickets_remaining - price

features.name: Built-in AI helper
features.description: Chat with 'Wiz' to choose a pool, design a request, interpret backtests, and explain the math plainly - running on local Ollama models or, with a key, a cloud model.
features.notes: /api/chat SSE; Ollama auto-detected; Anthropic/OpenAI optional

features.name: AI that drives the app
features.description: When asked to build/wheel/backtest, Wiz emits an action block the UI executes - so the AI's result is identical to pressing the buttons. It never invents numbers.
features.notes: lotterywiz action block; per-app prompts (F5, Universal, Super Sete, Scratch)

features.name: Ask Wiz to review
features.description: Send any built set's coverage/profile/tickets to the AI for a critique and adjustment suggestions.
features.notes: WizDock.review; on F5 + Universal results

features.name: Claude Desktop via MCP
features.description: Drive Lottery Wiz from inside Claude Desktop using the existing subscription (no paid API) - 11 tools covering generate, backtest, ledger, build, check winners and draw management.
features.notes: mcp_server.py registered in claude_desktop_config.json; needs a Claude Desktop restart to load

features.name: Export & save
features.description: Every result set can be printed, copied, downloaded as CSV or Excel, saved to a library, or logged as actually played.
features.notes: /api/export (csv/xlsx via openpyxl); /api/sets; /api/plays

features.name: My Plays dashboard
features.description: Profiles your logged plays as data: a coverage map of how often each number is played, typical shape, and the real scoreboard (each play matched to its date's actual draw -> spend/won/net).
features.notes: /api/plays/analyze; plays.db

features.name: Owner lock on presets
features.description: Public visitors can use every game and build their own, but the official preset game DEFINITIONS are read-only - only the owner (via secret link or password) can edit them.
features.notes: /api/owner/check constant-time (hmac.compare_digest); key in env or .owner_key, never returned

features.name: 24/7 service + public tunnel
features.description: Runs as the QI_LotteryWiz Windows service on port 8777, reachable publicly via a Cloudflare tunnel at a permanent QI domain.
features.notes: QI_LotteryWiz + QI_LotteryWizTunnel registered; user must run install_service.bat / install_tunnel.bat (UAC)

features.name: Offline mode
features.description: The Fantasy 5 page opens standalone from disk with embedded fallback draws and reference data when the server is not running.
features.notes: Fantasy5/data.js; no live updates / AI / xlsx / ledger in offline mode
